body:
**Investigation result (2026-07-10): cannot reproduce — the multi-org runtime does not currently exist to activate.**

- `@objectstack/organizations` (the enterprise plugin `serve.ts` tries to import under `OS_MULTI_ORG_ENABLED=true`) is not present in the cloud repo — `packages/security-enterprise` ships `hierarchy` / `ai-seat` / `license` only. The env flag today lands on the loud "running single-org" warning path.
- The cloud runtime's own multi-tenant wiring (`packages/objectos-runtime/src/artifact-kernel-factory.ts` ~L406) still imports **`@objectstack/plugin-org-scoping`**, which ADR-0081 retired from the framework — that dynamic import can only fail into its catch. Tracked on the cloud side (issue filed there).

So the predicted recurrence is real but **gated behind work that hasn't landed**: whoever builds the `organizations` package must pick one of the three fix directions in this issue at that time (per-org RBAC replay / RLS global-row carve-outs mirroring #2745's driver semantics / platform-table tenancy opt-out). Until then there is nothing enforceable to change in the framework — the open edition strips the wildcard tenant RLS and #2745 handles the driver layer. Leaving this open as the enterprise-track reminder with the design options recorded.
